Name: (CP) Pastel Horse
Author: OofLasagna
Description:
Ever wanted to have a horse that looks like it was from a famous children's show about ponies? Or maybe you, just like me, wanted a pastel horse to fit in with the aesthetic of your home. Or maybe the poor animal just blends in too well with the environment during the fall! Well, you're in luck :) This mod changes the horse from a brown to a light pink, easily standing out from the rest of the scenery.

Installation:

1 )  Download the file.

2 )  Open the Zip file, and drag the file inside into your mods folder. The main folder is titled [CP] Horse, so if you want it to be more recognizable then change the name of it.
